title: dampiera stricta var. oblongata
intro: Dampiera stricta var. oblongata, commonly known as Dampiera oblongata, is a plant species in the Goodenia family (Goodeniaceae) that is native to Western Australia. It is a shrub-like plant with small, blue to purple flowers. The health benefits of Dampiera oblongata include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
